Character Training Guide

Character Training uses FLUX LoRA technology to train a custom AI model on your specific character, logo, or subject. This enables you to generate infinite consistent variations.

Use Cases:

  • Consistent logo variations for marketing
  • Brand mascot in different scenarios
  • Product photography with your product
  • Character consistency across content

✅ Best Practices:

  • Use 10-15 high-quality images (more is not always better)
  • Include variety: different angles, backgrounds, lighting
  • Keep subject consistent across all images
  • Use well-lit, clear photos without heavy filters
  • Square or near-square aspect ratios work best

❌ Avoid:

  • Blurry or low-resolution images
  • Heavy editing or filters
  • Multiple subjects in one image
  • Inconsistent subjects across images

Once training is complete (30-60 minutes), use your character in prompts:

  1. Go to the Images tab → Generate
  2. Select your trained character from the dropdown
  3. Include the trigger word in your prompt (e.g., "TOK")
  4. Generate as usual!

Example Prompts:

  • "TOK logo on a billboard in Times Square"
  • "TOK character surfing at sunset"
  • "TOK product on a modern desk, professional photography"

Training Time:

  • Typical: 30-60 minutes
  • You'll receive notifications when complete
  • You can close the browser - training continues server-side

What Happens During Training:

  • Your images are processed and optimized
  • A custom FLUX LoRA model is trained on your character
  • The model learns the unique features of your subject
  • Once complete, you can generate unlimited variations!
